🌿 Tao Garden — a place you want to return to

Tao Garden is not just a hotel or retreat center, but a space for deep rest and restoration.
The territory is beautiful and well maintained, with gardens, water, lotus ponds, and a strong feeling of harmony from the very first moment.

It is easy to slow down here, breathe out, and truly relax — not only physically, but mentally as well.
The food is excellent, with fresh juices and coconuts, the staff is attentive and caring, and the rooms are comfortable. Everything is well organized, calm, and without rush.

The atmosphere is something special.
Tao Garden combines nature, Taoist philosophy, and a very mindful, gentle approach to people.
Even a simple walk through the garden feels like a small practice.

A perfect place for retreats, recovery, yoga, meditation — or simply for anyone who wants silence, beauty, and balance.

Very warm impressions. Highly recommended 🌿

I LOVE Tao Garden!
Tao Garden Health Spa & Resort is an abundant haven of holistic living. From the moment I arrived, I felt enveloped in an atmosphere of deep intention—an oasis where mind, body, and spirit are not only nurtured but truly uplifted. The grounds are serene and artfully designed, echoing a harmony that feels both ancient and refreshingly modern. Thank you to Master Mantak Chia for creating such a wonderful place!

What sets Tao Garden apart is its integrity. This is a place where wellness isn’t commercialized—it’s cultivated. There are thousands of beautiful trees, gardens, and lush, green landscapes in this oasis that spans over 30 acres. The air is clean and the chi is flowing.
The food is vibrant and nourishing, the accommodations are peaceful and thoughtful, and the entire environment invites you to reconnect with the best version of yourself.

The spa treatments themselves are transformative. Every practitioner brings a level of mastery, presence, and compassion that is rare to experience. Their massages and holistic healing modalities are delivered with a precision and soulful care that left me feeling lighter, clearer, and profoundly restored.

As an artist devoted to elevating human potential, I cherish spaces that heal and inspire; and Tao Garden is one of those rare places. It is a destination for anyone seeking renewal, clarity, and a return to their own inner alignment.

I highly recommended visiting Tao Garden Health Spa & Resort. It is true gem for the soul.

Thank you to Master Mantak Chia and the amazing staff at Tao Garden. You all are outstanding and you make every moment here a great experience!

I came here for a healing retreat to help with my health problems but only ended up going to the first day of class.  In a 4 hour session you are only allowed to go to the bathroom once when they have a break midway, you are told you should be able to hold it and called out for "letting the energy out of the room" if you leave.  So since I have numerous health problems, I just ended up watching it in my room instead, which was disappointing... they should tell you that before you sign up or I never would have, could have done it online for a fraction of the price... the resort itself is very run down,  and expensive for the quality of the rooms... I did really enjoy the saltwater pool though and the food was pretty good but again expensive... so I won't be back for another retreat,  that's for sure, and I don't recommend it unless you can go 2 hours without going to the bathroom 😬

A relaxing place for a health/detox retreat and also if you want to obtain knowledge and certifications in Taoism .

Mantak Chia is a knowledgeable, competent and honest Taoist master.

Its not necessarily an upmarket place where you would find the average yoga teacher or a lovely sound healing teacher or those in search of a superficial detox, the average self care path , the crowd is a little more mature, still seeking but more mature and in need of a bit more depth/knowledge.

Treatments arent necessarily all spa like or for " love island types" .Acupuncture, cupping, energy fields, all sorts can all be found here so it is a little more on the medical side . Meals are cooked in a way Taoists deem healthy and many chinese herbs are used here.

There is slightly nicer accommodation just a short walking distance from the complex

A good educational centre for health/taoism.

I was particularly impressed with the professionalism and maturity of a few of the teachers on site and using sound to release blocks from the body has been an interesting and effective therapeutic tool probably much needed in the West.

Let me say  off the top that I travel a lot and I write a lot of reviews on here. Scroll through and you will see that I am a VERY generous reviewer. I do not give bad reviews lightly.  I originally checked in to this centre thinking I would be there for six weeks. Thankfully I only paid up front for the first week. The $100 per night room was the quality of a dingy college dorm room. Old rickety furniture, dingy sheets and towels. The one spa treatment I had was totally uninspired.  The practitioner seemed bored and was definitely inattentive. The food was pretty whatever as well. This is Thailand. For $100 a night you can stay in some really beautiful, high quality places. The grounds of the place are nice, but everything else is shabby. Most disturbingly,  they did a VERY hard sell on a "detox" kit that Chia is selling through a Multi-Level Marketing scheme. I bought the kit but once I opened it and realized what it was, and that the herbs were VERY low quality, I immediately took the box back. They refused to take it back saying that there were no returns. I was already so disappointed with the quality of the place and Chia's behaviour that I just checked out. The pyramid scheme herb kits are outrageous.  He markets himself as an expert on health but there is literally somebody selling those same detox kits out of a kiosk in the middle of the Chiang Mai Mall. In the one week I was there, he and his staff did the hard sell on those kits, and then he took up two seminar periods to try to get all the students to sign up as distributors on the scheme. Multiple people complained.
